# 047 — GEO/AEO: direct-answer opener + FAQPage on token/chain pages

Risk tier: **HIGH** (verifier-confirmed, agrees with the builder's guess). Full walkthrough below, per NORTH_STAR's HIGH-lane requirement.

## Goal
Every `/tokens/<slug>` and `/chains/<slug>` page opens with a data-derived intro sentence, but none of them directly answer the head query ("what's the best/safest `<TOKEN>`/`<CHAIN>` yield right now?") in the extract-friendly, answer-first format 2026 AI retrieval rewards, and none carry `FAQPage` schema — the only `FAQPage` on the whole site was the kevin story page (040). ~70% of DeFi-category queries resolve inside AI answers today; this closes that gap for the ~2,000-page token/chain SEO surface.

## Intuition
Two additions, one shared cause: AI answer engines weight a page's *opening content* heavily for relevance, and reward explicit Q&A schema as citation fuel.
- **Direct-answer block** — 2 sentences, right after `<h1>`, that state the answer before any context: highest yield, on what protocol/chain, how many pools clear the floor, then the honesty disclosure (live data, anomaly exclusion). Answer-first, not "here's some context, eventually an answer."
- **FAQPage** — 3 Q&A pairs a real visitor would ask ("what's the highest yield today," "how many pools clear the floor," "are these rates safe") with visible HTML + matching JSON-LD `mainEntity`.

The one design decision worth calling out, mirroring 046's `poolHrefFor` pattern: both the answer text and the FAQ items are built by a *single* function (`buildAnswerAndFaq`) from the *same* already-gated inputs (`rec.pools[0]`, `rec.qualifyingCount`, `rec.totalTvl`) the visible table already uses. There's no second, independently-computed path that could cite a different (possibly anomalous) pool — the trust rail holds structurally, not because a test happens to check it.

## What changed and why (diff in reading order)

**`generate-token-pages.js`** (the shared module `generate-chain-pages.js` reuses):
1. `buildAnswerAndFaq(label, rec, bestApy, topPool, poolWord)` — pure function returning `{ answer, faq }` as RAW (unescaped) strings. Reads only `rec.qualifyingCount`/`rec.totalTvl`/the passed-in `bestApy`/`topPool` — never touches raw pool data, so it cannot see an anomalous or sub-floor pool even in principle (those never enter `rec.pools` upstream, in `rankTopTokens`/`rankTopChains`).
2. `renderAnswerBlockHtml(answerText, cssClass)` — `escapeHtml`s the answer into a `<p class="${cssClass}">`.
3. `renderFaqBlockHtml(faqItems, cssPrefix)` — visible Q&A markup, structurally identical to `generate-stories.js`'s existing kevin-page FAQ block (`st-faq-item`/`-q`/`-a`), renamed to this page's own scoped prefix.
4. `renderFaqJsonLd(faqItems)` — `{ "@type": "FAQPage", mainEntity: [...] }` built from the *same* `faqItems` array `renderFaqBlockHtml` renders, with the same `</`-escaping the existing `breadcrumbJsonLd`/`itemListJsonLd` use.
5. `renderTokenPage` — calls `buildAnswerAndFaq` right after the existing `itemListJsonLd`/`datasetJsonLd` construction, inserts a fourth `<script type="application/ld+json">` (the FAQPage block) after `datasetJsonLd`, and inserts the answer block right after `<h1>` and the FAQ block right after the pool table (before `relatedBlock`). New scoped CSS (`.tp-answer`, `.tp-faq*`) uses only existing design tokens (`var(--color-text)`, `var(--neuro-radius-md)`, `var(--neuro-shadow-subtle)`) — no hardcoded hex.
6. `module.exports` — added the four new functions so `generate-chain-pages.js` can reuse them (CLAUDE.md's reuse-before-inventing rule).

**`generate-chain-pages.js`**: identical shape of change — destructures the four new exports, calls `buildAnswerAndFaq(rec.chain, rec, bestApy, top, poolWord)`, inserts the same blocks at the same relative positions, adds the `.cp-answer`/`.cp-faq*` scoped CSS mirror.

**`test_token_pages.js` / `test_chain_pages.js`**: a new `"047 — direct-answer block + FAQPage (GEO/AEO)"` section in each — placement (after H1, before table), content correctness (real APY/count/TVL cited), FAQ item count (2-4), FAQ↔JSON-LD byte-for-byte match (HTML-entity-decoded comparison), trust-rail exclusion via the ANOM/Anom anomaly fixtures, per-token/chain content variance, XSS-safety of the new `<script>` tag, and an additive-only check (pre-existing title/canonical/robots/related-nav unchanged).

**`product-loop-kit/specs/047-notes.md`**: build notes — judgment calls (3 FAQ items, placement, escaping pattern reused from 040/stories, EN-only structure for 050) and the full test-run record, including the documented pre-existing Playwright/network sandbox gap (same as 040's).

## Deviations from spec
See `product-loop-kit/specs/047-notes.md` for full reasoning; summary:
- Shipped 3 FAQ items (spec allowed 2-4) — the exact three example questions the spec itself suggests, no padding.
- FAQ block placed after the pool table (not immediately adjacent to the answer block) — natural reading order: table → questions about the data → related links. Spec only required "after H1, before the table" for the *answer* block; FAQ placement was left to the builder.
- No live Playwright/browser verification in this sandbox (no `node_modules`, `yields.llama.fi`/CDN blocked) — matches the 040-notes.md precedent exactly; spec 047's acceptance criteria only require fixture-generated-page + programmatic verification, both done.

## Verifier outcome
Independently re-derived all 5 acceptance criteria (placement, FAQ↔JSON-LD byte match, trust-rail exclusion via the ANOM/Anom fixtures, additive-only diff, test wiring) and ran `test_token_pages.js` (59/59), `test_chain_pages.js` (53/53), and the NORTH_STAR canonical test command (190 assertions) directly — all PASS. Verifier agreed with HIGH risk tier. First pass flagged this `specs/047-pr.md` explainer as missing (required before a HIGH-tier merge, per NORTH_STAR and the 046 precedent) — added here; no code changes were requested.

## Quiz

1. Why can the direct-answer/FAQ content never cite an anomalous or sub-floor pool, structurally rather than by a separate filter check?
2. Why does the FAQPage JSON-LD use raw (unescaped) `q`/`a` strings while the visible HTML uses `escapeHtml`, and why doesn't that violate the "byte-for-byte match" requirement?
3. Why does the shipped FAQ have exactly 3 items instead of 2 or 4?
4. Why is this diff's risk tier HIGH rather than LOW, given it's additive with no change to the pool table or ranking?
5. What structural choice keeps a future Korean-translation pass (050) from requiring a rewrite of the callers?
